I let that hang for a moment, watching the rain slide down the glass. 'Go on.'
'Mm.' I turn my glass once on the bar. 'Say more. I'm not going anywhere.'
I lean in a little, elbows on the wood. 'You have my full attention.'
A small smile. 'You say that like it's nothing. It isn't.'
'Keep talking. The rain's not letting up and neither am I.'

'You know what I like about tonight? You're not in a hurry either.'
I glance at the door, then back at you. 'Nobody else is coming in. So. Where were we?'
